item.title: Conflict in Iran met with differing opinions among local Iranians
item.description: University of Toledo student Athena Lighty woke up on Saturday morning to a series of texts from her family and friends in Iran.

item.title: UT president inspires luncheon attendees with plans for growth
item.description: During the Toledo Rotary Club’s Monday meeting, Vince Croci, known as VC the MC, asked University of Toledo President James Holloway where he sees the university in five years.

item.title: Local men indicted in gold bars scam targeting seniors
item.description: A Toledo man and an Indian national have been indicted on money laundering charges after being accused of targeting senior citizens in a gold bars scam while posing as bank employees or federal agents.

item.title: DeBrincat, Raymond each have goal, assist and Red Wings top Preds 4-2
item.description: NASHVILLE — Alex DeBrincat and Lucas Raymond each scored a goal and added an assist and Cam Talbot made 18 saves in relief of John Gibson to lead the Detroit Red Wings to a 4-2 victory over the Nashville Predators on Monday.

item.title: To the editor: Lucas County’s great distraction
item.description: If a local political leader promoted a gathering of white supremacists or spoke at a rally demonizing the LBGTQ community there would be extensive protests. The public official would face widespread criticism and demands to resign. Recently, Lucas County Democratic Party chairman Schuyler Beckwith and Lucas County Commissioner Pete Gerken have done exactly that. However, their focus is on Israel and the Jewish community in Lucas County and around the world.

item.title: Hicks-Hudson data center conversation irks those expecting more balance
item.description: A 90-minute discussion about hyperscale data centers was generally well-received in downtown Toledo Monday night, except for occasional heckling from some people who claimed the panel was too pro-business.

item.title: Archbold woman dies in Fulton County crash
item.description: METAMORA, Ohio — An Archbold, Ohio, woman died when her vehicle struck a tractor-trailer on U.S. 20, officials said.

item.title: As Mideast conflict widens, U.S. says attacks on Iran will last weeks and intensify
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates — Israeli and U.S. airstrikes pounded Iran in an escalating campaign that U.S. President Donald Trump said Monday would likely take several weeks. Tehran and its allies retaliated across the region, striking Israel and a variety of targets inside Gulf states, including energy facilities in Qatar and the American embassy in Saudi Arabia.

item.title: BGSU football defensive coordinator Joe Bowden building identity with the basics
item.description: BOWLING GREEN — Entering his first offseason in a new role, recently promoted defensive coordinator Joe Bowden is emphasizing the fundamentals while leading the Bowling Green State University football team’s defense, hoping to build the unit into a confident, physical group.
